text: Sinno Men muuyuno okkugol kala wonkii peewal makki, Men newinaynayno ki ɗum. Ko woni tun, Hikma An on e nunɗal an ngal waɗɗinii konngol immorde e An, hebbinirgol Jahannama on Ñalnde Darngal, yoora k'o'e en, yedduɓe ɓen ka jinna e ka yimɓe, tawde ɓe suɓike laawol yeddugol e majjere ngol, ɓe acci laawol gomɗinal e peewal ngol.
